name: Infoblox — DNS Rebinding Attempt
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Response" and xdm.event.outcome = "SUCCESS"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter domain    = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0),
        answer_ip = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, " IN A (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0)
| filter domain != null and answer_ip != null
| filter not (domain contains ".local" or domain contains ".lan" or domain contains ".internal" or domain contains ".corp")
| alter is_private = if(incidr(answer_ip, "10.0.0.0/8") or incidr(answer_ip, "172.16.0.0/12")
                        or incidr(answer_ip, "192.168.0.0/16") or incidr(answer_ip, "127.0.0.0/8")
                        or incidr(answer_ip, "169.254.0.0/16"), 1, 0)
| alter private_ip = if(is_private = 1, answer_ip, null),
        public_ip  = if(is_private = 0, answer_ip, null)
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp sum(is_private) as private_answers,
       count_distinct(public_ip) as public_answers,
       values(private_ip) as private_ips,
       values(public_ip) as public_ips,
       values(answer_ip) as ip_list
       by xdm.source.ipv4, domain, _time
| filter private_answers >= 1 and public_answers >= 1
| alter client_ip = xdm.source.ipv4
| fields client_ip, domain, private_ips, public_ips, ip_list
description: Same client + domain resolving to multiple distinct answer IPs — rebinding attack.
alert_description:
What fired: Same client + domain resolving to multiple distinct answer IPs — rebinding attack.

Why it matters: a host is communicating with known-bad or anomalous infrastructure (C2 / malicious domain). Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1568 - Dynamic Resolution (TA0011 - Command and Control).

Investigate:
  - Identify the internal client and the domain/IP contacted, and check reputation + resolution history.
  - Look for the initial delivery vector (email/web/download) and any beaconing cadence or follow-on payloads from the same host.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
